title: Forbid accessing team secrets with environment variable as global secret

target.summary: `_is_team_specific_accessed_as_global` only guards against team-specific secret IDs when `team_name` is None and fails to match team names containing underscores. Consequently, a team-scoped lookup for another team's namespaced secret falls through to the global environment lookup, exposing other teams' connections and variables.
notes: faulty helper method that only checks when team_name is None and fails to match team names containing underscores
call site in get_conn_value relying on the faulty helper
